# v0.6.0 — Explanations (partial publish)

## Highlights

- **`ontologos-explain`** and CLI `explain` command
- Brief **whelk** EL delegation experiment (reverted in **v0.6.1**)
- **RL/RDFS → reasonable** via `ontologos-bridge`
- **Partial crates.io publish:** `ontologos-core`, `ontologos-parser`, `ontologos-profile`, `ontologos-query` only (whelk git dependency blocked bridge/el/rdfs/rl/explain)

## Published crates

- **crates.io:** partial **0.6.0** (core, parser, profile, query)
- **PyPI:** `ontologos` **0.6.0**

## Upgrade notes

Upgrade to **v0.6.1** for the full library set and restored in-house EL. See [`.github/release/v0.6.1.md`](v0.6.1.md) and [docs/migration/v0.5.x-to-v0.6.0.md](../../docs/migration/v0.5.x-to-v0.6.0.md).
